name: Hurston
description: The fourth planet of the Stanton system, owned and operated by Hurston Dynamics. An arid industrial world with a harsh environment, marked by massive factories, refineries, and mining operations. Lorville is the primary landing zone, a sprawling industrial city dominated by the Hurston Dynamics headquarters tower. The surface is scarred by centuries of resource extraction.

name: Lorville
description: The primary city and landing zone on Hurston. A sprawling industrial metropolis dominated by the Hurston Dynamics corporate headquarters. Features the Teasa Spaceport for ship spawning and storage, the HD Showcase for weapons and armor, and various industrial facilities. Notable districts include the Central Business District, the residential areas, and the industrial outskirts.

name: microTech
description: The third planet of the Stanton system, a frozen world owned by the microTech corporation. The planet's surface is covered in snow and ice, with temperatures well below freezing. New Babbage, the primary landing zone, is built in a protected valley and features a blend of modern architecture with natural scenery. The planet is known for its cutting-edge technology sector.

name: New Babbage
description: The corporate headquarters and primary city of microTech, nestled in a sheltered valley on the frozen planet. New Babbage features the Commons area with shopping, the Aspire Grand hotel, and the MT Showcase for equipment. The city connects to the surface via the transit system and features an underground spaceport.

name: ArcCorp
description: The second planet of the Stanton system, completely urbanized by ArcCorp Industries. The entire surface is covered by a single massive city under atmospheric domes and artificial structures. Area18 is the primary landing zone, a dense metropolitan hub with manufacturing facilities, commercial districts, and residential sectors stretching for thousands of kilometers.

name: Area18
description: The primary landing zone on ArcCorp. Area18 is a bustling metropolis with towering skyscrapers, neon-lit streets, and constant aerial traffic. Features the Plaza shopping area, the ArcCorp Showcase, and various corporate facilities. The spaceport provides full ship services.

name: Crusader
description: The first and largest planet of the Stanton system, a gas giant owned by Crusader Industries. The planet features a vibrant atmosphere with multiple cloud bands and storms. Crusader's floating platforms house industrial facilities and the company's aerospace manufacturing operations. Orison is the primary platform city suspended in the upper atmosphere.

name: Orison
description: The floating city of Orison, suspended in Crusader's upper atmosphere on massive floating platforms. Home to Crusader Industries' headquarters and ship manufacturing facilities. Features open-air platforms with breathtaking views of the gas giant below. The city includes shopping, ship showrooms, and industrial facilities connected by a network of skywalks and trams.

name: Port Tressler
description: The orbital station serving microTech. Positioned in low orbit above New Babbage, Port Tressler is a major transit hub for the planet. Features landing services, cargo facilities, ship shops, weapon and armor stores, medical facilities, and a bar. The primary gateway for travelers arriving at or departing from microTech.

name: Everus Harbor
description: The orbital station serving Hurston. Everus Harbor is a utilitarian station reflecting the industrial character of Hurston below. Provides full services including landing platforms, cargo handling, ship sales, equipment shops, and medical facilities. A key refueling stop for ships operating in the Hurston area.

name: Baijini Point
description: The orbital station serving ArcCorp. Positioned above the planet-wide city, Baijini Point handles the massive traffic flow to and from ArcCorp's surface. Offers comprehensive services including cargo facilities, ship sales, equipment shopping, and medical care. Named after the historic Baijini trading network.

name: Seraphim Station
description: The orbital station serving Crusader. Seraphim Station orbits above the gas giant, serving as the primary spaceport for visitors not heading to Orison's atmo platforms. Features full services including landing bays, cargo processing, ship showrooms, equipment stores, and medical facilities.

name: R&R HUR (Hurston Orbit)
description: A Rest & Relaxation station in Hurston's orbit. These standardized stations provide essential services for travelers including refueling, basic supplies, and a place to rest. Smaller than major orbital stations but strategically located for convenient access.

name: R&R MIC (microTech Orbit)
description: A Rest & Relaxation station in microTech's orbit. Provides refueling, basic supplies, and rest facilities. A convenient stopover for ships operating in the microTech area without needing to descend to the surface or visit Port Tressler.

name: R&R ARC (ArcCorp Orbit)
description: A Rest & Relaxation station in ArcCorp's orbit. Serves as a convenient mid-point for logistics and a quick stop for pilots needing supplies without entering ArcCorp's busy airspace.

name: R&R CRU (Crusader Orbit)
description: A Rest & Relaxation station in Crusader's orbit. Provides standard services for pilots transiting through the Crusader area. Often used as a staging point for operations in the wider Stanton system.

name: HUR-L1 Lagrange Station
description: Lagrange point station at Hurston's L1 point. These deep-space stations serve as navigation hubs and refueling stops for ships traveling between planets. Features cargo facilities and limited services. Located at the gravitational equilibrium point between Hurston and Stanton's sun.

name: HUR-L2 Lagrange Station
description: Lagrange point station at Hurston's L2 point. A deep-space station providing refueling and cargo services for ships operating on the far side of Hurston's orbit. Less trafficked than L1 but still maintains essential services.

name: MIC-L1 Lagrange Station
description: Lagrange point station at microTech's L1 point. Serves as a deep-space navigation and refueling hub for the microTech orbital region. Features cargo and refining services for ships operating in the area.

name: MIC-L2 Lagrange Station
description: Lagrange point station at microTech's L2 point. A more remote deep-space station providing essential services for ships operating beyond microTech's main traffic lanes. Popular with miners and salvagers working the outer asteroid fields.

name: ARC-L1 Lagrange Station
description: Lagrange point station at ArcCorp's L1 point. A deep-space hub serving the high traffic corridor around ArcCorp. Features comprehensive cargo and refining services to support the massive industrial output of the planet below.

name: ARC-L2 Lagrange Station
description: Lagrange point station at ArcCorp's L2 point. Provides refueling and cargo services on the far side of ArcCorp's orbit. A strategic stop for ships avoiding the congestion around ArcCorp's main shipping lanes.

name: CRU-L1 Lagrange Station
description: Lagrange point station at Crusader's L1 point. One of three Lagrange stations serving the Crusader gas giant region. A major deep-space hub for the busy Crusader shipping lanes, connecting traffic to and from the other planets.

name: CRU-L2 Lagrange Station
description: Lagrange point station at Crusader's L2 point. A secondary deep-space station serving the Crusader region. Popular with miners due to proximity to the Belt alpha asteroid cluster.

name: CRU-L3 Lagrange Station
description: Lagrange point station at Crusader's L3 point. The most remote of Crusader's Lagrange stations, positioned at the far point of the gas giant's orbit. A quiet outpost that serves as a waypoint for ships traveling to the Pyro system jump point.

name: Arial
description: Named after the 3rd CEO of Hurston Dynamics, Arial Hurston, who was known for creating the controversial Life/Labor-style employee contract. A barren rocky moon orbiting close to Hurston.

name: Aberdeen
description: Named after scientist Aberdeen Hurston who was credited with designing the company's first antimatter warhead. A small barren moon with evidence of past mining operations.

name: Magda
description: Named after Hurston Dynamics CEO Magda Stanton who made the decision to purchase Stanton I from the UEE. A small, geologically inactive moon.

name: Ita
description: Named after Ita Hurston, who died during the First Tevarin War. The smallest of Hurston's moons.

name: Cellin
description: Named after the youngest of three siblings from a 25th century children's tale. Features over a hundred dormant volcanoes. Rocky terrain with volcanic features.

name: Daymar
description: Named after the middle brother from a 25th century tale. The largest of Crusader's moons with a slightly eccentric orbit. Sandy desert terrain with canyons and mesas. Popular for ground vehicle racing.

name: Yela
description: Named after the oldest sibling from a 25th century tale. Has a water-ice crust representing Yela's cool nature. Famous for its asteroid belt and underground criminal hideouts.

name: Lyria
description: An icy moon featuring active cryogeysers and cryovolcanoes. Rich in minerals and a popular destination for miners. Surface marked by frozen volcanic formations and ice plains.

name: Wala
description: A low-density moon particularly susceptible to tidal forces, resulting in a noticeably prolate shape. Barren surface with minimal atmosphere.

name: Calliope
description: Named after the ancient Greek muse of eloquence. A frozen moon with icy plains and rocky outcroppings.

name: Clio
description: Named after the ancient Greek muse of history. A small frozen moon with ice-covered surface and minimal geological activity.

name: Euterpe
description: Named after the ancient Greek muse of music. A frozen moon with a heavily cratered surface and ice deposits.

name: Pyro I
description: The innermost planet, orbiting very close to Pyro's volatile star. A silicate-crusted world with high atmospheric pressure and extreme temperatures. Despite powerful winds and frequent lightning, a resilient ecosystem endures.

name: Monox (Pyro II)
description: A coreless terrestrial planet nicknamed 'Monox' for the toxic carbon monoxide in its atmosphere. Despite a temperate climate, terraforming was impossible due to Pyro's volatile star. Bears scars of old Pyrotechnic Amalgamated mining. Now a haven for outlaws.

name: Bloom (Pyro III)
description: An icy terrestrial world with a naturally breathable atmosphere. Once a major mining hub, now overrun by outlaws and former miners. Despite its dangerous inhabitants, Bloom has the most Earth-like conditions in the system. The epicenter of outlaw civilization in Pyro.

name: Pyro IV
description: Scarred by a catastrophic collision with a planet-sized body in the distant past. The impact knocked it into orbit around Pyro V. On a slow collision course with the gas giant — destined to crash or form rings.

name: Pyro V
description: The largest planet in Pyro. A gas giant with striking green and yellow atmospheric swirls. Hydrogen is harvested from its upper atmosphere for fuel. Pyro IV orbits dangerously close and will eventually collide with this giant.

name: Terminus (Pyro VI)
description: A frigid, barely-habitable planet with a methane-laced atmosphere. Breathable but prolonged exposure is harmful. Ruin Station, the former Pyrotechnic Amalgamated main hub, orbits here — a lawless den where competing gangs clash for control.

name: Ruin Station
description: The primary station in Pyro, orbiting Terminus. Originally Pyrotechnic Amalgamated's main hub, now controlled by XenoThreat. Features drug labs, a black market, and constant gang warfare. The de facto seat of power in the system.

name: Checkpoint Kareah - Pyro
description: A heavily fortified security checkpoint station in the Bloom region. Controls access to key shipping lanes. Often a site of conflict between rival pirate gangs.

name: Checkpoint Greehey
description: A rough checkpoint station popular with pirates and smugglers operating around Monox. Minimal services but a reliable place to refuel and gather intel.

name: Checkpoint Smolensky
description: A strategically located checkpoint monitoring the orbital zone between Pyro IV and V. Used as a staging point for operations across the inner system.

name: Checkpoint Ragnar
description: A station at the edge of Pyro V's hydrogen harvesting zone. Frequently visited by fuel haulers and miners extracting from the gas giant's atmosphere.

name: Checkpoint Sheriff
description: A contested checkpoint in Terminus orbit. Site of frequent clashes between gangs vying for control of lucrative Ruin Station trade routes.

name: Stanton-Pyro Jump Point
description: Medium bidirectional jump point connecting Pyro and Stanton. The primary gateway between the lawless frontier and UEE-controlled space.
